[[Rijeka|City of Rijeka]] (30%) | chrtitle = President | chairman = [[Damir Mišković]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Matjaž Kek]] | league = [[Croatian Football League]] | season = [[2025–26 Croatian Football League|2025–26]] | position = 4th of 10 | pattern_la1 = _rijeka2526h | pattern_b1 = _rijeka2526h | pattern_ra1 = _jomablack | pattern_sh1 = _rijeka2526h | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = | body1 = | rightarm1 = | shorts1 = | socks1 = | pattern_la2 = _rijeka2526a | pattern_b2 = _rijeka2526a | pattern_ra2 = _jomawhite | pattern_sh2 = _rijeka2526a | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = | website = {{official URL}} | current = 2026–27 HNK Rijeka season }} '''Hrvatski nogometni klub Rijeka''' ({{langx|en|Croatian Football Club Rijeka}}), commonly referred to as '''HNK Rijeka''', is a Croatian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Rijeka]]. The club competes in the [[Croatian Football League]] (HNL), the top tier of the [[Croatian football league system]]. Rijeka have played their home matches at [[Stadion Rujevica]] since August 2015. Plans to replace or reconstruct the club's former home, [[Stadion Kantrida]], remain under development; in June 2026 the City of Rijeka announced that it intended to pursue a new project with state support, but no agreement had yet been signed.{{cite news |last=Cupać |first=Damir |title=Grad Rijeka odustaje od Miškovićevog "Povratka na Kantridu", grade stadion u suradnji s državom |url=https://www.novilist.hr/rijeka-regija/rijeka/grad-rijeka-odustaje-od-miskovicevog-povratka-na-kantridu-grade-stadion-u-suradnji-s-drzavom/ |work=Novi list |date=5 June 2026 |language=hr |access-date=11 August 2026}} The club's traditional colours are white and blue.{{cite web |title=Novi dresovi s potpisom Juraja Zigmana inspirirani riječkom kišom |url=https://nk-rijeka.hr/novi-dresovi-s-potpisom-juraja-zigmana-inspirirani-rijeckom-kisom/ |website=HNK Rijeka |date=13 July 2026 |language=hr |access-date=11 August 2026}} The club traces its origins to ''Club Sportivo Olimpia'', a multisport organisation established in 1904 whose football activity is first documented in 1906.{{cite journal |last=Lazzarich |first=Marinko |date=2014 |title=Stoljetno iščitavanje povijesti pod stijenama riječkoga sportskog hrama |url=https://hrcak.srce.hr/136951 |journal=Problemi sjevernog Jadrana |volume=13 |issue=13 |pages=47–76 |publisher=[[Croatian Academy of Sciences and Arts]] |language=hr |access-date=11 August 2026}} Olimpia and Gloria merged in 1926 to form [[U.S. Fiumana]]. In 1946, S.C.F. Quarnero/Kvarner was formally constituted as a new legal entity but inherited players and elements of Fiumana's sporting tradition. Historians have consequently differed over the degree of institutional continuity and the appropriate foundation date.{{cite news |last=Horvat |first=Zlatko |title=Istraživanje riječke nogometne povijesti: "NK Rijeka sigurno nije osnovana 1946. godine, poveznica s Fiumanom je jako čvrsta" |url=https://www.novilist.hr/rijeka-regija/rijeka/istrazivanje-rijecke-nogometne-povijesti-do-prije-30-ak-godina-puno-se-toga-o-rijeci-nije-smjelo-ni-pisati-ni-govoriti/ |work=Novi list |date=31 January 2021 |language=hr |access-date=11 August 2026}} The club adopted the name NK Rijeka in 1954 and HNK Rijeka in 1995. Rijeka have won two Croatian league titles, two [[Yugoslav Cup]]s, seven [[Croatian Football Cup|Croatian Cups]] and one [[Croatian Football Super Cup]]. They won the Croatian league and cup double in 2016–17 and again in 2024–25.{{cite web |title=Rijeka slavi dvostruku krunu: protiv Slavena osvojila i Kup |url=https://hns.family/vijesti/29532/rijeka-slavi-dvostruku-krunu-protiv-slavena-osvojila-i-kup/ |website=Croatian Football Federation |date=29 May 2025 |language=hr |access-date=11 August 2026}}"}}
